title: Baron Samedi, 2000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Life and Power Symbolism on the Reverse The purple color and the gravedigger’s outfit emphasize Baron Samedi’s role as the ruler of cemeteries, while also symbolizing extravagance and the pleasures of life. The bottle of rum with chili peppers is an offering and delicacy for the Baron during rituals, symbolizing the spirit of celebration and his connection between the living world and the dead. The serpent coiling around him represents life force, rebirth, and the primal power that the Baron controls. Mysticism and Power Symbols on the Obverse The skull painting symbolizes control over death and the spirit world. The surrounding candles and mystical elements highlight his magical power and role as an intermediary between worlds. Incense, chains, and protective symbols strengthen the spiritual power of Baron Samedi, making him an important guide and protector of the afterlife. “He is a trickster (…) engaging in licentious behavior as he ridicules those who take themselves too seriously”. – Encyclopedia Britannica
